speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Please describe exactly where you are feeling the wrist pain and how it limits your hand movement. To help me narrow this down, do you recall any specific injury or repetitive activity that started these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: 34-year-old female. The patient reports experiencing pain in her right thumb and wrist, which radiates to her elbow for the past three months. The pain worsens when she holds her infant son and is alleviated somewhat with an ice pack. She mentions a history of falling on her right outstretched hand about six months ago. She also notes that her mother has a history of chronic joint pain treated with methotrexate. The patient has been taking ibuprofen as needed for her symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: De Quervain's tenosynovitis with possible extension of Carpal Tunnel Syndrome.

REQUEST TEST: Nerve conduction study of the right upper extremity; Ultrasound of the right first dorsal compartment.
